# Car

Show a car's battery or charge level, with optional range and vehicle controls.

## Configure in the editor

1. Open a page in the [web editor](../editor.md#layout-workspace) and add **Car**.
2. Use **Search** beside the entity field to choose an entity by name. Configure its options below.
3. Resize the widget for its content, then **Save** the layout. Try its controls on the panel.

Assign the battery sensor first, then optional range, charging, temperature, lock and pre-conditioning entities.

## Entities and interaction

**Supported primary entities:** `sensor.*`

| Setting / behaviour | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Extras | from 200 px width and 330 px height: pre-conditioning entity (switch/climate/button/select), lock/status entity (lock or door binary sensor), interior-temperature entity -- all three render as a row of read-only labels/icons under the rings, except pre-conditioning entity which is a real button |
| Interaction | read-only rings; the optional precond button (if configured) is directly tappable, lock and interior temperature are not |

## Layout limits

- Minimum: **200 × 200 px**.
- Maximum: **480 px × 560 px**, capped by the selected display device's dashboard area.
- Leave space for the value, title and touch controls; the minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size.

The [display device overview](../choose-display.md) lists usable dashboard geometry. [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains title/content spacing and touch targets.
